note: Statements by WHO that name a hospital and its status, quoted word for word. The newest per hospital is shown on the site.

statuses.partially_functioning: WHO says the hospital is partially functional or operational, or has resumed partial operations.
statuses.not_functioning: WHO says the hospital is non-functional, non-operational or out of service.
statuses.destroyed: WHO says the hospital has been destroyed.
statuses.services_reported: WHO names services running at the hospital but does not state its overall status.
